From Heaven's Door · Price: the target must see your drawing or your stand's face.

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: 1 action: a creature that can see your stand (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will}) turns into a book, its pages torn open: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[mental]] (@Check[will|against:stand|basic]{basic Will}). Failure: you read one fact and can write a minor command in it for 1 round (see 5th); critical failure: three facts, the command, and it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{stunned 1}. Each fact is the true answer to one question you ask about the creature: what a Recall Knowledge success would tell you (a weakness, a resistance, its best or worst save, an ability), or something it personally knows or remembers.
  • 5: Your minor commands can be any short order ("can't Strike you", "can't speak", "drop to the ground"), still for 1 round. Surge (incapacitation): rip a page as you write, @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[mental]] (@Check[will|against:stand|basic]{basic Will}), and on a failure the command lasts 1 minute.
  • 9: 1 action: write one short order on yourself or a willing ally your stand touches, lasting 1 minute (e.g. "can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened}", "acts quickly" for +2 initiative, "speaks this language").
  • 13: Tear a page: the creature forgets the last 10 minutes.
  • 17: Your commands can be anything the command spell can do (outside a fight, lasting 1 hour; incapacitation).

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
